title: Dual-host parity matrix (machine-readable twin)
scope: Entire product — all chart types, not graph-only.
architecture_principle: GraphForge/canonical → Rust (layout, viewport, graph LOD, edge LOD, encode, render-graph emission, all mark decisions) → bounded §29 buffers → shared WebGL browser client (paint only). Hosts are thin; browser never reimplements layout/LOD/encode on the product path.

runtimes.name: Python host
runtimes.notes: Primary notebook UX; first-class and must not regress.

runtimes.name: Node host
consumers: VS Code extensions (consumer of Node bindings — not a separate stack)
owns: progressive force scheduling off the browser main thread
runtimes.notes: VS Code uses packages/xy-node; do not invent a fourth runtime stack.

runtimes.name: Browser client
must_not: reimplement layout/LOD/encode in JS for the product path
import koffi, node:fs, or other Node-only modules
runtimes.notes: Shared renderer for every host; draws uploaded §29 buffers only.

invariants: Rust owns decisions for all marks; hosts are thin
Same figure spec + §29 buffers across Python and Node for the same inputs
Notebook show()/anywidget/to_html() remain first-class and must not regress
Node package must not use browser-only APIs; browser client must not import koffi/node:fs

pipeline_layers.notes: Never browser main-thread decisions; Barnes–Hut/grid approx at scale
Paint / pick / gestures only; no raw V/E past direct tier; no JS layout/LOD/encode product path

mark_kinds.notes: layout, force, LOD, render-graph; tests/test_graph_node_parity.py circle goldens + dual-host force benches
layout in Rust; Node composeSankey thin loader; band polygons follow-up
packages/xy-node marks/scatter + charts.scatterChart; tests/test_node_mark_parity.py encode f32 goldens
packages/xy-node marks/line M4 via xy_m4_*; tests/test_node_mark_parity.py index-count goldens
packages/xy-node marks/histogram via xy_histogram_uniform; tests/test_node_mark_parity.py fixed-edge counts
packages/xy-node marks/area reuses line M4 ingest + base; tests/test_node_mark_parity.py stable-sort goldens
alias of bar via charts.columnChart; shares xy_bar_stack
packages/xy-node marks/box single-group via xy_box_stats; multi-group follow-up
packages/xy-node marks/ecdf via xy_weighted_ecdf + histogram binned path; tests/test_node_mark_parity.py
packages/xy-node marks/segments pass-through; graph/sankey already emit segments traces
packages/xy-node marks/heatmap grid + xy_heatmap_rgba; categorical axes follow-up
packages/xy-node marks/hexbin via xy_hexbin; tests/test_node_mark_parity.py lattice goldens
packages/xy-node marks/violin single-group via xy_violin_density; multi-group follow-up
Node polarChart shell + pie/wind_rose composers; full polar payload still Python-first
Node composePie / pieChart over bar wedges; sector geometry via existing ABI
Node composeWindRose via xy_wind_rose_bins + stacked polar bars
Node facetChart stub: compose N figures or composePanel(key); shared-axis FacetChart remains Python
